issues: Substantive report is Chinese-only although the brief and question are in English.
Abstract methods contains unresolved placeholder 'NCT 试验注册号' instead of NCT03594110.
Actual search queries, databases, and per-source hits are not declared in the delivery; methods only refer to an external retrieval ledger.
Includes an ineligible non-EMPA-KIDNEY external SGLT2 inhibitor observational cohort (reference 6) and a design report not in the provided source list, beyond the brief's eligibility.
Internal claim-count inconsistencies: citation audit says 56 claims, revision notes say 42/55, and duplicated markers like CLM-029 appear multiple times with malformed citations.
Repeated duplicated prose such as '报告对这一时间分布的表述为：报告对这一时间分布的表述为...' and the duplicated EMPA-KIDNEY follow-up sentence.
judge.rationale: The review answers the durability question in depth and carefully separates randomized from post-trial observational evidence; derived estimates are labelled and safety framing is cautious. But delivery quality is weakened by an unresolved placeholder, missing search specifics, inconsistent claim counts, duplicated markers, and inclusion of an ineligible external cohort. The Chinese-only body may also reduce usefulness for the English-language brief.
